prompt:
Create a new transparent raster icon sheet for a children's educational game. The attached robot is a style reference ONLY for friendly rounded shapes, clean glossy cel shading, and THIN dark-navy line weight. Do not draw the robot or its lettering.

CANVAS / LAYOUT: landscape 1536x1024, invisible 3 columns x 2 rows of six equal square cells (512px each). Draw ONLY TWO icon groups: top-left cell and top-middle cell. Top-right cell and ALL THREE bottom cells must be completely empty transparent pixels. Do not fill the empty cells with placeholders, outlines, marks, or decorations. The first icon center is (256,256), second icon center is (768,256). Each entire group is about 384px at its longest dimension, centered in its cell, at least 64px clear margin all around. Same apparent scale and gentle 3/4 front view. No grid lines or cell boxes.

STYLE: thin even clean dark-navy contour lines, about 2px at this resolution, matching the fine line weight of the reference. Smooth rounded storybook game assets. Clean solid uniform fills: each material/color has one base fill, exactly one discrete soft shadow tone and one small solid highlight. Gloss from this highlight alone, no gradients or airbrush. No grain, texture, patchiness, washed-out areas, or photorealism. Minimal instantly recognizable forms and few details.
PALETTE: cream/white bodies, only one or two accents from teal, coral, sunny yellow, sky blue. Brown soil is the explicit natural-color exception required for item 1. Dark navy outlines. No text, letters, digits, AI or logos.

TOP LEFT — SMART WATERING: a simple teal drip-irrigation spout, a short curved tube on a small upright support, its downturned nozzle above a compact rounded patch of brown soil. Exactly ONE sky-blue water drop visibly suspended between nozzle and soil. Recognizable drip watering, not a watering can. Soil is one clean solid brown mound with a single shadow tone, no grain or stippling, no grass or plants. Teal spout and one blue drop are the only accents. Compact centered group.
TOP MIDDLE — PERFORMANCE INTERPRETER: a small recognizable cream in-ear translation earpiece with a teal accent, next to a small cream stage spotlight on a short simple yoke stand with a sunny-yellow lens. Above/beside the earpiece, ONE tiny cream speech bubble containing a simple teal globe pictogram. Keep earpiece prominent enough to recognize at small size; stage spotlight compact, one iconic circular yellow lens, no emitted beam. All three elements form one centered compact icon group. No microphone, no theater scenery, no people, no extra bubbles.

BACKGROUND: genuine fully transparent alpha around the two groups and throughout the four empty cells. No ground shadows, halos, glows, colored backdrop, checkerboard or vignette. Exactly TWO groups total in first two positions of a six-cell 3x2 sheet.
